original_query: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE a.content CONTAINS 'FFS' RETURN a.resolutionId, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, a.content ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC LIMIT 10
question_en: List the agreements containing open FFS items (further-study backlog).
reference_query:
MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting)
WHERE a.content CONTAINS 'FFS'
WITH a,m,reduce(state={lines:[],stopped:false}, line IN split(a.content,'\n') |
 CASE WHEN state.stopped OR line =~ '^R2-[0-9]{6,}\\t.*'
 THEN {lines:state.lines,stopped:true}
 ELSE {lines:state.lines+[line],stopped:false} END) AS own
WITH a,m,[line IN own.lines WHERE line CONTAINS 'FFS' | split(line,'FFS')] AS segmented
WITH a,m,[parts IN segmented | [i IN range(0,size(parts)-2) |
 {before:reduce(s='',j IN range(0,i) | s+parts[j]+CASE WHEN j<i THEN 'FFS' ELSE '' END),
 after:reduce(s='',j IN range(i+1,size(parts)-1) | s+CASE WHEN j>i+1 THEN 'FFS' ELSE '' END+parts[j])}]] AS perLine
WHERE any(markers IN perLine WHERE any(marker IN markers WHERE NOT (
 (((marker.before+'FFS') =~ '(?is).*\\bFFS$') AND marker.after =~ '(?is)^\\s+(?:(?:can|may|shall|will|should|must)\\s+be\\s+)?(?:deleted|removed|closed|resolved)\\b.*')
 OR ((marker.before =~ '(?is).*\\b(?:remove|delete|close|resolve)\\s+(?:(?:the|corresponding|this|that)\\s+)*$') AND ('FFS'+marker.after) =~ '(?is)^FFS\\b.*')
)))
WITH DISTINCT a,m
RETURN a.resolutionId AS resolutionId,m.meetingNumberInt AS meetingRank,a.sequence AS sequenceRank
ORDER BY meetingRank DESC,sequenceRank ASC
